environment.description: CLI tool deployed as a microservice behind a REST API gateway (FastAPI wrapper) on EKS. The API exposes POST /decrypt endpoint that accepts ciphertext, IV, and key-id parameters and returns the JSON result directly to the caller. CloudHSM cluster (hsm-cluster-abc123) holds AES-256 keys. No rate limiting configured. API responses include full error messages from the decrypt function. Container runs with NET_RAW capability for health checks. Service mesh (Istio) sidecar present but in permissive mode with no AuthorizationPolicy applied.

config.hsm: AWS CloudHSM cluster, CU user with decrypt permission on key
config.network: ALB -> FastAPI wrapper -> CLI tool invocation
config.error_handling: full error propagation to HTTP response
